focus.title: 美国拟将东南亚四国太阳能产品关税恢复至2012年水平，中国厂商需评估供应链调整
focus.summary: 据美国贸易代表办公室近期公告，美方拟于2026年8月底前结束对柬埔寨、马来西亚、泰国、越南四国太阳能电池及组件的关税豁免，恢复至2012年反倾销/反补贴税率水平。此举将直接影响中国企业在上述地区的产能布局。建议相关企业尽快核查原产地规则与供应链安排，评估关税成本上升幅度，并考虑将部分产能转移至美国本土或享受免税待遇的国家，同时关注美国海关针对规避行为的执法动向，做好合规预案。
focus.source: 来源：美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）公告 · 2026.08.06
focus.title_en: U.S. Plans to Reinstate 2012-Level Tariffs on Solar Products from Four Southeast Asian Countries; Chinese Manufacturers Should Assess Supply Chain Adjustments
focus.summary_en: According to a recent announcement by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR), the United States intends to end, by the end of August 2026, the tariff exemptions on solar cells and modules from Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam, reverting to the anti-dumping/countervailing duty rates from 2012. This move will directly impact the production capacity Chinese enterprises have established in these regions. Companies are advised to promptly review rules of origin and supply chain arrangements, assess the magnitude of tariff cost increases, consider relocating some capacity to the U.S. or tariff-free countries, and monitor U.S. Customs enforcement against circumvention, with compliance contingency plans in place.
focus.source_en: Source: Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) announcement · 2026.08.06

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境股权代持协议因违反中国外资准入规定被认定无效
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起涉及中国境内企业的股权代持争议作出裁决，认定代持协议因违反中国《外商投资准入特别管理措施（负面稿）》中的禁止性规定而无效。仲裁庭认为，尽管协议约定适用新加坡法律，但根据中国法律强制性规定，该代持行为规避外资准入审批，损害公共利益，故裁决代持关系不成立，并驳回实际出资人要求确认股权的请求。该案提示跨境投资者在采用代持结构前，必须严格审查目标行业的外资准入限制，避免因违反中国强制性法律导致协议无效。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）裁决摘要 · 2026.08.06
case.title_en: SIAC Award: Cross-Border Shareholding Nominee Agreement Rendered Void for Violating China's Foreign Investment Access Rules
case.summary_en: In a recent award, the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) ruled that a shareholding nominee agreement involving a China-based company was void for violating the prohibitive provisions of China's 'Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List)'. The tribunal held that despite the agreement's choice of Singapore law, the arrangement circumvented foreign investment access approval and harmed public interest under Chinese mandatory law, thus the nominee relationship was not established, and the claim of the actual investor to confirm shareholding was dismissed. The case reminds cross-border investors to carefully review industry-specific foreign investment restrictions before adopting nominee structures, to avoid invalidity due to contravening Chinese mandatory laws.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规：内地与港澳间重要数据出境实行负面清单管理
policy.summary: 为促进粤港澳大湾区数据跨境安全有序流动，国家网信办等三部门于2026年8月5日联合发布《粤港澳大湾区（内地、香港、澳门）数据跨境流动便利化管理办法（试行）》，自2026年9月1日起施行。办法明确，对于重要数据出境，实行负面清单管理，清单外的一般数据可自由流动；同时简化个人信息出境标准合同备案流程，并设立大湾区数据跨境流动安全评估绿色通道。企业需对照负面清单识别自身数据是否属于重要数据，并完善数据分类分级与合规机制。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室等三部门联合发布 · 2026.08.06
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules for the Greater Bay Area: Negative List Management for Important Data Outbound between Mainland, Hong Kong and Macao
policy.summary_en: To facilitate secure and orderly cross-border data flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), the Cyberspace Administration of China and two other departments jointly issued on August 5, 2026 the 'Measures for Facilitating Cross-Border Data Flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao) (Trial)', effective from September 1, 2026. The Measures adopt a negative list management for outbound transfer of important data, allowing free flow of general data outside the list; they also streamline the filing process for standard contracts for personal information transfer, and establish a green channel for security assessment of cross-border data flow within the GBA. Enterprises should compare against the negative list to identify whether their data constitutes important data, and improve data classification and compliance mechanisms.
policy.source_en: Source: Joint issuance by the Cyberspace Administration of China and two other departments · 2026.08.06

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期将尽，中国企业需抓紧完成CBAM申报准备
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收期。目前，出口钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力、氢能等产品的中国企业，须在2026年10月31日前提交第四季度过渡期报告，并持续完善排放数据核算。建议企业尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，对接欧盟认可的第三方核查机构，同时评估供应链中的间接排放影响。若未按期申报，将面临每吨未申报排放20-50欧元的罚款。此外，可考虑通过优化生产工艺、采用绿色电力等方式降低碳成本，并关注欧盟后续公布的默认值调整。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · 涉外法律团队分析 · 2026.08.06
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: As EU CBAM Transition Period Nears End, Chinese Enterprises Must Expedite CBAM Compliance Preparation
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The transitional period of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will end by the end of 2026, with the definitive regime commencing in 2027. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, electricity, and hydrogen must submit the Q4 transitional report by October 31, 2026, and continuously improve emission data accounting. Companies are advised to promptly establish product-level carbon footprint accounting systems, engage EU-recognized third-party verifiers, and assess indirect emission impacts in the supply chain. Failure to report on time may result in fines of €20-50 per tonne of unreported emissions. Additionally, consider reducing carbon costs through process optimization or green electricity procurement, and monitor future adjustments to default values announced by the EU.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law · Cross-border legal team analysis · 2026.08.06
